description: Runs the monitor as root on Ubuntu. A local file repository serves a planted package, tctest-apt-pkg, so the result does not depend on what Ubuntu has published that day: installed at the repository's version it is healthy, and once the repository carries a newer version it alerts. A package that does not exist reports healthy (the documented 'cannot tell up to date from not installed' limit), an empty PACKAGE is refused, and a second run is harmless. TERM mid-run still prints one fallback result block, within 5 seconds.

steps.label: Plant tctest-apt-pkg 1.0, installed, in a local repository
Publish tctest-apt-pkg 2.0 to the local repository
TERM mid-run (apt-get hanging): one fallback result block at once, saying it was stopped by a signal; the job ends 143
